features.name: glucose_bmi_interaction
features.description: Interaction term between plasma glucose and BMI, scaled down to prevent extreme values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a linear model with a non-linear interaction term that is highly relevant to metabolic health.

features.name: age_adjusted_pregnancies
features.description: Ratio of pregnancies to age, capturing the frequency of pregnancies over the patient's lifespan.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes pregnancy count by age, creating a smoother feature for linear margins.

features.name: insulin_resistance_proxy
features.description: A proxy for insulin resistance using glucose and insulin levels, applying log1p to handle zero values and skewness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous severity measure of metabolic dysfunction suitable for SVM margins.

features.name: bmi_deviation_from_healthy
features.description: Absolute deviation of BMI from a standard healthy baseline (22.5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms a raw metric into a continuous severity measure of weight abnormality.

features.name: glucose_severity_score
features.description: Measures how far glucose exceeds a normal fasting threshold (100), clipped at 0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a hinge-like feature that activates only when glucose is elevated, ideal for linear SVMs.

features.name: metabolic_syndrome_risk_index
features.description: A weighted composite of standardized glucose, BMI, and blood pressure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects multiple risk factors into a single approximate linear dimension.

features.name: pedigree_age_risk
features.description: Combines genetic predisposition (pedigree function) with age risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the compounding effect of age and genetics in a single continuous feature.

features.name: blood_pressure_extremes
features.description: Absolute deviation of blood pressure from the dataset mean, highlighting both unusually high and low values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts a potentially non-monotonic relationship into a monotonic severity score.

features.name: skin_thickness_mass_ratio
features.description: Ratio of skin thickness to BMI, potentially indicating body fat distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized structural feature that may separate different body types.

features.name: zero_measurement_count
features.description: Counts the number of biologically implausible zero values across key measurements (skin, insu, pres, mass).
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a linear indicator of missing data patterns, which often carry predictive signal.

features.name: clinical_severity_assessment
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the patient's overall metabolic profile based on the combination of glucose, BMI, and age, outputting a continuous risk score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex, non-linear clinical heuristics that are difficult to express in simple formulas, providing a smooth score for SVM.

features.name: genetic_risk_interpretation
features.description: Semantic interpretation of the diabetes pedigree function in the context of the patient's age and current metabolic state.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates the abstract pedigree function into a more actionable, continuous risk magnitude.
